raw.query: WITH expected_rho(rho) AS (VALUES (10::numeric), (15::numeric), (20::numeric), (25::numeric)), current_dim AS (SELECT d.run_id, d.rho, d.window_name, d.superseded_by FROM provenance.v_dim d WHERE d.is_current = true AND d.policy = 'reactive' AND d.rho IN (10,15,20,25)), current_cells AS (SELECT d.rho, d.run_id, d.window_name, i.is_violation FROM current_dim d JOIN provenance.v_infraction i ON i.run_id = d.run_id AND i.is_current = true), totals AS (SELECT rho, COUNT(*) AS cells, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_violation = false) AS passes, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_violation = true) AS violations FROM current_cells GROUP BY rho), windows AS (SELECT rho, jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('window', window_name, 'passes', CASE WHEN is_violation = false THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, 'cells', 1) ORDER BY window_name) AS per_window FROM current_cells GROUP BY rho), superseded AS (SELECT d.rho, COUNT(*) AS noncurrent_rows, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE d.superseded_by IS NOT NULL) AS rows_with_superseded_by FROM provenance.v_dim d WHERE d.is_current = false AND d.policy = 'reactive' AND d.rho IN (10,15,20,25) GROUP BY d.rho) SELECT e.rho, COALESCE(t.passes,0) AS passes, COALESCE(t.cells,0) AS cells, COALESCE(t.violations,0) AS violations, w.per_window, COALESCE(s.noncurrent_rows,0) AS noncurrent_dim_rows, COALESCE(s.rows_with_superseded_by,0) AS noncurrent_rows_with_superseded_by FROM expected_rho e LEFT JOIN totals t USING (rho) LEFT JOIN windows w USING (rho) LEFT JOIN superseded s USING (rho) ORDER BY e.rho
